summary: Iteration 29 FULL PASS. Backend: 12/12 pytest cases pass in ~5.3s (backend_iteration29_test.py) — (a) POST /api/invoices with mixed gst_free items + ttp:true returns subtotal 185.12, gst 5.00 (only the non-gst-free $50 item), total 190.12, ttp persisted, per-item service_date/start_time/end_time/gst_free all round-trip via POST->GET; (b) invoice-number uniqueness after delete verified — created INV-N, deleted it, created another → new number strictly greater than deleted one (persistent counter in db.counters proven); (c) PUT /api/invoices/{id} recomputes totals correctly (100 non-gst + 50 gst-free => subtotal 150, gst 10, total 160), preserves ttp, updates per-item gst_free/start/end/service_date; (d) GET /api/invoices/{id}/pdf returns 200 application/pdf with %PDF magic bytes for a ttp+mixed-gst invoice, pypdf extraction confirms 'TTP' marker AND 'TEST Iter29 Trading' account name appears in the payment details section; (e) PUT /api/settings {account_name} persists + GET returns it; (f) POST /api/clients with next_of_kin dict persists, GET returns it, PATCH updates it (name/relationship both change), GET verifies; (g) POST /api/scan-document returns 401 without token (privacy) and 500 with junk base64 while auth is present — server does NOT crash (GET /api/ still 200 after); (h) POST /api/client-documents with extracted_text/doc_date/key_parties persists, GET /api/client-documents?client_id=X returns them intact; (i) regression — tasks CRUD (POST/GET?date=/PATCH/DELETE), duplicate invoice endpoint (new id, new number, preserved items), /invoices+/clients+/tasks lists all 200. Frontend (390x844, owner login, onboarding skipped): (1) New Invoice /invoice/new — all required testIDs present (ttp-toggle, service-date-input, issue-date-input, due-date-input, compliance-panel, item-sdate-0-0, item-start-0-0, item-end-0-0, item-gstfree-0-0, item-rate-0-0, item-qty-0-0, item-desc-0-0, save-invoice-btn); compliance checklist DOES include 'Invoice dated on/after service date(s)' (green tick since svc_date == today by default). (2) Totals recompute live: qty=2 rate=100 → subtotal $200 · GST-free ON → GST $0.00 · Total $200.00; toggling GST-free OFF → GST becomes $20.00 (10%) · Total $220.00; toggling back re-zeros GST. (3) TTP toggle ticked → compliance count jumps to 7/8 (only Due date red because we skipped filling it — that's expected UI, not a bug). (4) Save Draft created INV-1010 successfully → dashboard shows 'Create your first invoice' marked done. (5) Invoices list shows the new invoice; opening it → detail screen renders 'Claim type: TTP' badge on the header meta line, and each line item is annotated 'GST-free · 09:00–11:00' — matches spec (the 'Delivered:' prefix is only on the PDF per spec, not the detail screen; detail line reads 'GST-free · <start–end>' which is functionally equivalent and cleaner). (6) Business Settings /settings — testID setting-account_name renders between Bank and BSB, filled 'TEST Iter29 Trading' → save-settings-btn → success (modal even offered 'Apply updates to draft invoices?' showing INV-1010 as candidate — nice UX). (7) Clients — added a new client with Next of Kin fields (nok-name Jane FE Kin / nok-relationship Mother / nok-phone +61400555666 / nok-email jane@example.com) → save → client profile shows the Next of Kin card (testID nok-card) with name/relationship/email + a tappable phone chip (testID nok-call) — screenshot confirms card layout. (8) Client profile → Documents '+' opens the modal with 3 buttons — doc-camera + doc-gallery + doc-ai-scan (AI Scan) all present as required; created a doc manually (title 'TEST FE doc iter29', Save) → doc row appears; tapping the row opens the detail sheet (testID doc-view-sheet). (9) Planner — /planner renders planner-screen; add-task-fab tapped → task modal → title 'TEST iter29 shift' + type shift + save → planner-summary chip appears showing '1 shift 0/1 done'; tapped task ROW → edit sheet opened pre-filled with delete-task-modal-btn present; changed title to 'EDITED' + Save → row updates; tapped checkbox toggle-task-<id> → summary changes to '1/1 done'; re-opened edit sheet → tapped delete-task-modal-btn → task disappears. Every planner flow item in the spec passed. No red-screen errors. Console warnings limited to pre-existing shadow*/pointerEvents RN-Web deprecation notices — no regression.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:774 _next_invoice_number() correctly uses BOTH max(existing INV-* numbers) AND db.counters seq — guarantees no reuse across deletes. Verified by test.
server.py:766 compute_invoice_totals() applies GST only on items with gst_free=False — matches spec (default True keeps NDIS supports GST-free).
server.py:365 /scan-document uses Depends(current_org) — 401 without token verified; junk base64 returns HTTP 500 with 'Extraction failed:' detail, server stays alive.
server.py:2336 PUT /invoices/{id} recomputes subtotal/gst/total on every edit AND preserves ttp via payload.model_dump() — correct.
server.py:1173 Client.next_of_kin is a plain dict — Pydantic keeps it lossless, PATCH via /clients/{id} with body {next_of_kin: {...}} replaces the sub-doc atomically.
server.py:1687 PDF builder adds 'Account name: ...' line under Payment Details when bg('account_name') is set — verified by pypdf text extraction.
server.py:2314 /client-documents accepts extracted_text/doc_date/key_parties on the ClientDocCreate schema — new fields round-trip cleanly.
